Samira (Reliability): Quick follow-up from the all-hands reliability Q&A. RCA here: https://internal.redwood.com/rca/INC-2301112. Posting immediate owners and short asks so we can close action items.

Marcus (CTO): Thanks. Leadership needs: 1) a short public status blurb, 2) an internal one-pager for execs with customer impact and whether credits are likely.

Ken (SRE): I can draft the status blurb and include a one-line "what we did" for Support. ETA: 2301112600.

Ivy (Product): Need decision on hotfix vs scheduling into planned cache work. If hotfix, prefer a canary rollout.

Samira (Reliability): Short summary: config drift caused unexpected cache fallback under a specific load spike. Patch mitigated; recurrence unlikely but possible. Recommend patch + regression test now; refactor scoped next sprint.

Riley (Support): Please include a suggested customer reply sentence so Support can mirror tone.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2301112: RCA uploaded and linked; tasks created.

Samira (Reliability): Action items (owner -> due):
- Ken -> status blurb + support reply (due 2301112600)
- Ivy -> create roadmap ticket + triage (due 2301113000)
- Marcus -> approve exec one-pager & SLA stance (due 2301112800)
- Samira -> add regression test & CI job (due 2301113600)
- Riley -> prep support reply templates (due 2301112900)

Ken (SRE): Ack. Posting draft to #support-desk in 20m and will ping Legal if wording needs review.

Ivy (Product): Ack. I’ll scope hotfix vs refactor options and add acceptance criteria for triage.

Riley (Support): Ack. Will draft templates once Ken posts blurb.

Marcus (CTO): Ack. I’ll review exec note after Ken posts so numbers align. No SLA credits expected yet; will confirm after impact calc.
